description: This C# source file defines the class MemoryGrainStorageProviderBuilder, which implements IProviderBuilder for ISiloBuilder. It configures memory grain storage options for Orleans silos, including setting the number of storage grains and potentially a serializer based on configuration.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorageProviderBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for configuring in-memory grain storage in Orleans silo host environment.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures memory-based grain storage options for the given silo builder, reading settings from the provided configuration section.
